name: Вигідні взяття
description:
Sometimes you can capture a loose piece in more than one way. Or there might be two or three capturing options. Watch out! Make sure you do no take the wrong piece. And be careful not to use the wrong piece for capturing. A bad choice can get you into trouble.

Always ask yourself:

  • Are there any loose pieces?
  • Can I capture these loose pieces?
  • If I have a choice, which is the best piece for me to capture? And what is the best way to do it?

What do you have to do?
Take a loose piece and win material. Make sure to choose the best loose piece and the best way of capturing.

examples.text: White would like to capture the bishop. This can only be done one way, because the knight is pinned.
Pay attention to the enemy pieces. White wants the knight to remain covered. Thus white captures the black knight with the rook.
